items.title: Sanofi agrees to buy Insmed in $41bn deal
items.summary: Sanofi has agreed to buy US respiratory drug developer Insmed for $175 a share in cash, about $41bn, gaining two marketed medicines including Brinsupri.

items.title: Sanofi reportedly weighing a buyout of Insmed, developer of respiratory drug Brinsupri
items.summary: Fierce Pharma, citing Bloomberg, reports Sanofi may be considering acquiring Insmed as it faces the Dupixent patent cliff. Report only, unconfirmed by either company.

items.title: GE HealthCare adds Lung Guidance and AutoAS artificial intelligence tools to Vscan Air SL handheld ultrasound
items.summary: GE HealthCare announced two features for the Vscan Air SL on 03/11/2026: Lung Guidance (probe guidance across the eight-zone lung protocol, with B-line detection and scoring) and AutoAS (a diagnostic aid flagging possible moderate-to-severe aortic stenosis from at least two views).

items.title: PCRS webinar: health inequalities in asthma care for children, 30 November
items.summary: Primary Care Respiratory Society webinar for UK healthcare professionals on 30 November, 19:00 to 20:00, on asthma care inequalities, diagnosis and urgent to primary care working.

items.title: GSK eyes Exdensur filings after phase 3 result in EGPA
items.summary: GSK reported positive phase 3 results for depemokimab (Exdensur) in EGPA, a rare vascular inflammatory disease, and is looking at approval filings beyond severe asthma.

items.title: PCRS webinar: SNOMED coding in primary care respiratory conditions, 10 December
items.summary: Primary Care Respiratory Society webinar on 10 December at 18:00 on why accurate SNOMED coding matters for respiratory conditions in primary care.

items.title: NIV/NHF Consumables
items.summary: Guy's and St Thomas' NHS Foundation Trust. 3 year agreement at Guy's and St Thomas NHS Foundation Trust, relating to a range of airway consumables which are compatible with existing equipment deployed within the Trust.

items.title: Improve vaccine access for people with lung conditions, taskforce concludes
items.summary: Too many people with lung conditions are missing out on vital vaccines, according to a taskforce calling for better education and easier access. A survey of more than 2,200 adults with lung conditions commissioned by the Taskforce for Lung Health found many did not see themselves at risk.

items.title: Enterprise secures EMA orphan status for CF therapy
items.summary: Enterprise Therapeutics has EMA orphan designation for ETD001 in cystic fibrosis, supported by positive phase 2 data.

items.title: Hull University Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust — Neighbourhood COPD Risk Stratification Population Health Project (C491927)
items.summary: This project aims to develop and implement a specialist-led, integrated neighbourhood model of care for people living with COPD across Hull and East Yorkshire.

items.title: Preliminary Market Engagement Questionnaire - Tracheostomy Tubes, Tube Holders and Accessories
items.summary: Regional Business Services Organisation Procurement and Logistics Service. This is a Prior Information Notice to seek engagement with the market place to gather information associated with the supply and delivery of Tracheostomy Tubes, Tube Holders and Accessories.

items.title: Vaping could increase risk of COPD, preliminary research suggests
items.summary: Vaping several times a day may cause persistent changes in lung function in young people putting them at increased risk of a chronic and life-limiting lung condition, a new study has suggested.

Fisher and Paykel locked in as sole supplier for respiratory consumables at St George's
items.summary: St George's University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust has made a direct, sole-source award to Fisher and Paykel Healthcare worth £750,000 for invasive, non-invasive and nasal high-flow consumables, citing their compatibility with equipment the trust already has in place.

items.title: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV): vaccination for older adults
items.summary: Information on respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) and the benefits of vaccination for adults and resources to promote the vaccination to older adults.

items.title: Acute respiratory illness in PPDs and the CYPSE
items.summary: Managing acute respiratory illness (ARI) in prisons and other prescribed places of detention (PPDs) and in the Children and Young People Secure Estate (CYPSE).
